event_data.context:
Agents can produce locally functional changes that add a second mutable store for facts already owned by an established architecture. That creates divergent sources of truth, weakens replay and recovery, and bypasses the project's documented review boundaries. The Development System should make agents inspect the relevant architecture and authoritative implementation, extend that model, or pause for an explicit architecture decision before creating another persistence authority.

Implementation notes

Add the sanitized regression scenario and behavior rubric from GitHub issue #77 to the engineering-standards and development-workflow evaluation coverage. Review responses and resulting changes for duplicate authority, bypassed domain transitions, dead compatibility paths, and tests that validate only the new side mechanism.

Source: https://github.com/jwilger/ai-plugins/issues/77
event_data.summary: Ensure implementation guidance identifies and respects a project's existing ownership and persistence model before adding durable state.
event_data.title: Keep new durable state within a project's established architecture
